attchmntText: Pursuant to the Regulation 32(6) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 read with Regulation 173A of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018, enclosed herewith is the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 issued by CARE Ratings Limited, Monitoring Agency for the utilisation of the proceeds raised through Qualified Institutions Placement and Rights Issue.
voiceSummary: Genesys International Corporation Limited has filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The report was issued by CARE Ratings Limited, the Monitoring Agency. It covers the utilization of proceeds raised through Qualified Institutions Placement and Rights Issue. The filing is pursuant to Regulation 32(6) of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. It also references Regulation 173A of the SEBI Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2018. The information is available on the company website at www.igenesys.com. The document was signed by Kushal Jain, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. The submission was made to BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Ltd. on November 13, 2026.

attchmntText: Genesys International Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates Grant of 3,65,000 (Three Lakhs Sixty Five Thousand) Employee Stock Options to the eligible employees of the Company under Genesys Employee Stock Option Scheme, 2022 ( Scheme ), including 4,640 (Four Thousand Six Forty) Employee Stock Options being re-granted out of the options previously lapsed under the Scheme.
voiceSummary: Genesys International Corporation Limited approved its unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a profit after tax of 528.88 lakhs, compared to 718.26 lakhs in the previous quarter. Revenue from operations stood at 7,779.81 lakhs. The Board also granted 3,65,000 Employee Stock Options under the Genesys Employee Stock Option Scheme, 2022. These options carry an exercise price between Rs.70 and Rs.100 per share. The company proposed revising the utilization of Qualified Institutional Placement proceeds. An amount of Rs.2438.96 lakhs is proposed for technology development, while Rs.4000 lakhs is proposed for bank loan repayment. This proposal is subject to shareholder approval at the upcoming Annual General Meeting.

attchmntText: Genesys International Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Press Release - Un-audited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.".
voiceSummary: Genesys International Corporation Limited filed press release regarding un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated total revenue stood at Rs. 89.99 Crore, up 11.39% year-on-year. EBITDA was Rs. 28.16 Crore. Profit after tax was Rs. 6.44 Crore, up 20.91% quarter-on-quarter. The company provides advanced mapping, survey, and geospatial services.
